paite: "Israel suante houpih inla, a-inkuan chih a tuam ding in chiang khat chiat, a-inkuan uh dungzui zel a a-intekpen tengteng zah, chiang sawm-le-nih la inla; achiang uah amin uh gelh in.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and take rods from them, one for each fathers’ house, of all their princes according to their fathers’ houses, twelve rods. Write each man’s name on his rod.

paite: Levi chiang ah Aaron min gelh inla; a-inkuan chih uh a ding in chiang khat zel ahi ding ahi.
english: You shall write Aaron’s name on Levi’s rod. There shall be one rod for each head of their fathers’ houses.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin thu theihsakna ma ah na koih dia, huai ah i kimu ding.
english: You shall lay them up in the Tent of Meeting before the covenant, where I meet with you.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, ka tel ding mi chiang asel ding; huchi in Israel suante na tung a aphunna uh ka daisak ding,” achi hi.
english: It shall happen that the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall bud. I will make the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against you, cease from me.”

paite: Mosi in Israel suante ahoupih a, a-intekpen tengteng in amau inkuan chih a tuam a ding, intekpen chih in chiang khat zel, chiang sawm-le-nih apia uhi. Huaite lak ah Aaron chiang leng atel sam hi.
english: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and all their princes gave him rods, for each prince one, according to their fathers’ houses, a total of twelve rods. Aaron’s rod was among their rods.

paite: Mosi in theihpihna biakbuk ah TOUPA ma ah huai chiangte akoih hi.
english: Moses laid up the rods before Yahweh in the Tent of the Testimony.

paite: Azing in hichi ahong hi a, theihpihna puanin ah Mosi ava hoh a; ngai in, Levi inkuante a dia Aaron chiang ana sel a, pakmum asuah a, apakpalh a, vaisuaklu min asuang hi.
english: On the next day, Moses went into the Tent of the Testimony; and behold, Aaron’s rod for the house of Levi had sprouted, budded, produced blossoms, and bore ripe almonds.

paite: Mosi in TOUPA ma a pan chiang tengteng Israel tengteng kiang ah alakhia a; ana en ua, amau chiang chiat ala uhi.
english: Moses brought out all the rods from before Yahweh to all the children of Israel. They looked, and each man took his rod.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Helhat tate ahi uh chih theihsak zelna ding in Aaron chiang theihpihna bul ah koih nawn in. Huchi in ka tung a ahelna uh na daisak thei ding, asihlouhna ding un," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Put back the rod of Aaron before the covenant, to be kept for a token against the children of rebellion; that you may make an end of their complaining against me, that they not die.”

paite: Huchibang in Mosi in TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in ahih hi.
english: Moses did so. As Yahweh commanded him, so he did.

paite: Israel suante'n Mosi kiang ah, "Ngai in, ka si ua, ka mangthang uh, ka vek un ka mangthang uh.
english: The children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, “Behold, we perish! We are undone! We are all undone!

paite: TOUPA biakbuk kiangnai a hong pai peuhmah asi ding uh. Kou leng si in ka mangthang ding uh maw?" achi uhi.
english: Everyone who keeps approaching Yahweh’s tabernacle, dies! Will we all perish?”
